scientific_integrity: Unrestricted symbolic proof in RESULT.md; independent validation not performed. Finite reproducibility checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Exact for indices with at most two distinct prime factors. No general formula for three or more distinct prime factors and no global resolution of the source rank conjecture is claimed. An equivalent unindexed classical formulation is a residual novelty risk.
title: Two-prime index rigidity for associated Pell gcds
